title: Operations New Scraper Entry Permission Consistency

items.action: open and select generic operation creation entries
authorize the Scraper operation start action
discover and select the mandatory fair for a new Scraper operation
discover mandatory adapter and manifest metadata for a new Scraper operation

backend.reason: Scraper immediate create/start authorization already uses fair_crm.scraper.execute.

api.reason: No API contract changes; existing fair and scraper read clients/endpoints remain authoritative for mandatory wizard discovery.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

forms.reason: No business form behavior changes; the existing type-picker permission filter is reused.

notes: The Scraper new-operation entry and its deep link are available only when scraper.execute, fairs.read, and scraper.read are all granted. The two read permissions are legitimate wizard prerequisites because the user must browse/select a fair and scraper adapter/manifest. The final Scraper Start action itself remains scraper.execute-only. Enrichment entry requires scraper.execute plus scraper.read, while Enrichment Start remains execute-only. Bulk Email entry requires fair_emails.execute plus mail_templates.read and email_accounts.read, while already-created Bulk Email Start/Retry and final Send remain execute-only. Generic operation entries continue to require operations.create.
